title.en: Signing in to Gemini with a Google account now actually opens the sign-in

description.en: Clicking Sign in opened a terminal that went straight to Gemini's chat screen, with the Google sign-in nowhere in sight — so the panel kept saying "not signed in", correctly, because nothing had happened. The CLI remembers the last sign-in method it was given, and for anyone who had ever entered an API key that is the one it keeps using; there is no option to tell it otherwise from outside. The sign-in now runs in a folder of the launcher's own, where it asks for the Google account flow just for that run. Your own Gemini settings are left exactly as they are, so an agent already working on its API key keeps working even if you close the sign-in halfway.
